summary: A Virginia county attorney is reported to have advised that a blanket moratorium likely lacks legal standing because localities must consider each rezoning or special exception application on its individual merits.

source.citation: Regional reporting and advocacy accounts, July through September 2026

notes: A neighboring Virginia city is reported to distinguish a pause pending ordinance revision from a moratorium, described there as a total wipeout of one specific use. That distinction appears to be a drafting response to the same constraint.
confidence_note: No written opinion has been read and no Virginia Code section is cited here. Reported advice, not a published legal conclusion.
